caveat: Published AA / Liquid AI results, not Thimvale measurements. Reasoning modes and 16K evaluation context differ from this app's non-thinking, 4K setup. Speed excludes model loading, image encoding, tools, and retrieval. Memory and compatibility still depend on the device and file.

picks.title: Balanced
picks.reason: Near the top mobile score with much faster generation than the quality-first pick. A good starting point for chat and file questions.

picks.title: Quick replies
picks.reason: A smaller non-thinking model for short conversations and lighter-memory phones. Less capable on difficult questions.

picks.title: Small download
picks.reason: A compact alternative with a strong speed result. Its published quality score uses reasoning mode; that is not an app accuracy guarantee.

picks.title: Text and images
picks.reason: A capable 4B-class option with image support. Image input also needs its matching vision file; the benchmark below is text-only.

picks.title: Quality first
picks.reason: The highest 16K mobile score in this review. Its generation is slower than the balanced pick, and it needs more memory.

picks.title: Higher RAM
picks.reason: Fast published generation with a competitive score. Tiny refers to active compute: all 7.9B parameters still occupy storage and memory.
